info.title: GiNi manufacturing demo API
info.description: Synthetic demonstration (not a Siemens system). Commands are validated server-side and executed in MongoDB transactions.

post.summary: Sign in with employee ID + demo PIN (PIN is a string; leading zeros count). Sets host-only HttpOnly session cookie + CSRF cookie for the calling app.
Revoke the session
Change own PIN/password
Create a session (scenario_control): mode INTERACTIVE (fork at checkpoint) or REPLAY
PLAY | PAUSE | SPEED | SEEK (seek: replay only)
Reset an interactive session to its checkpoint (confirm text "RESET <sid>")
Enqueue a recalculation or recovery-option job (202)
Execute a command (Idempotency-Key header required; expected entity version in body where relevant). See x-commands.

get.summary: My shift, current task, draft inspections, next actions, points
My assigned tasks, joinable operations, eligible queue (DR-1.0 order) and planned work
My labour categories, completed work, crew shares, points ledger, pending investigations
Task detail (instructions, milestones, crew, material, time)
Full plant workforce (filters: shiftOnly, workCenterId, role, state, q, page)
Order lines with good/scrap/WIP buckets and forecast band
Inspection with versioned checklist and specifications
Alerts (evaluation + workflow states), notifications, rule evaluation
Order forecasts, cutoff bands, work-centre predictions, recovery options
Recovery actions with before/after and verification

post.summary: Authorise a photo upload (Cloudinary signed fields or local adapter URL)
Verify the stored upload server-side
Create worker (manage_workers)
Deactivate
Activate
Reset PIN

get.summary: Import manifests, seed runs, reconciliation, quarantine

post.summary: Retry a dead job

get.summary: Environment banner: environment (FRESH_FACTORY | SYNTHETIC_DEMO), factory name, operating mode, plant date + timezone; database NAME only when signed in. Never secrets.
Fresh factory: 10-step setup checklist with completion state, configurationSaved / readyToRelease / readyToStart (factory_configuration | operational_supervision | manage_workers)
Fresh factory: all configuration (work centres, stations, skills, equipment, materials, shift templates, products + routes, checklists)
Fresh factory: per-tank readiness (material, station, equipment, qualified worker, crew, checklist) with blockers (?unitId=)

put.summary: Save factory settings: factoryName, siteId, timezone, operatingMode MANUAL_TEAM_TEST|SIMULATED_TEST, serialPrefix, workday (factory_configuration)
Create / update a work centre (audited; triggers RECALC)
Create / update a material (stock starts at 0; receive with MATERIAL_RECEIPT)
Create / update a shift template (start/end incl. overnight, breaks, workdays); regenerates the 60-day calendar

post.summary: Regenerate the shift calendar and rosters 60 days ahead

put.summary: New checklist version for an inspection gate (old version archived to ctq_check_history; open inspections keep their pinned snapshot)

post.summary: Create / revise a product with route, crew, labour standards, milestones, material (DRAFT when incomplete, RELEASED when complete; dryRun supported)
Release a DRAFT product once it is complete
Import the illustrative template into an EMPTY configuration (confirm "IMPORT ILLUSTRATIVE TEMPLATE"); never workers, orders or history

get.summary: Reset preview: database name, factory name, counts that would be removed (factory_reset; disabled unless ALLOW_FACTORY_RESET=true, never in production)

post.summary: Guarded reset of operational data (confirmText "RESET <database>" + factory name + acknowledge). Keeps admins and the audit; workers / configuration only removed when clearWorkers / clearConfiguration. Never run at start-up
Engine agents: batch of commands (Bearer INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN)
Engine: dispatch claimed notifications through Nodemailer
